description: Reviewed rules with their conditions, provenance and remaining limits.

detail.scope: Selected reviewed rules, with their original authority, conditions and limits. This is not an exhaustive mechanics guide.

name: Community confirmations

rule_views.conditions: DrBloodborne, Discord on 18 September 2026, displayed 16:43; screenshot supplied by Jeremy. No battle report/world context provided.
rule_views.limits: Accepted player testimony for S2, consistent with Lisan. Not a developer statement or direct Codex battle observation. No full probability or selection algorithm established.
rule_views.statement: DrBloodborne confirms that random catapult targeting can hit Thornsnare Grove.
rule_views.title: Random catapult targeting of Thornsnare Grove

rule_views.conditions: Lisan, Discord follow-up displayed 18 September at16:49; screenshot supplied by Jeremy. No actual level22 field shown.
rule_views.limits: Accepted clarification of economic versus technical feasibility; consistent with client level22 listing. Does not prove a specific level22 build or define costs/storage by world speed.
rule_views.statement: Lisan clarifies that his comment about level-22 fields on slower worlds means too expensive, not a game-imposed prohibition.
rule_views.title: Level-22 capital fields and economic feasibility

rule_views.conditions: Lisan, Discord follow-up displayed 18 September at16:49: if also a City level13, if normal village10; explicitly qualifies fields previously13+. World/speed/event date absent.
rule_views.limits: Accepted player testimony about reduction ceilings. Lower fields are not upgraded. Exact timing of the reduction remains unanswered; no capital move performed by Codex.
rule_views.statement: Lisan reports that former-capital fields above the applicable cap are reduced to level13 in a City or level10 in an ordinary village.
rule_views.title: Former-capital resource fields

rule_views.conditions: Lisan al-Gaib of Throne; Discord reply shown under 17 September 2026 in screenshots supplied by Jeremy. Original experience date, world and speed not provided. See L18_COMMUNITY.
rule_views.limits: Accepted for the original level-effect question; external bonuses and world-specific award caps are not established by this testimony.
rule_views.statement: Lisan reports that the Festival Grounds level changes celebration duration, not CP awarded per celebration.
rule_views.title: Festival Grounds level and celebration reward

rule_views.conditions: Lisan al-Gaib of Throne; Discord reply shown under 17 September 2026 in screenshots supplied by Jeremy. Original experience date, world and speed not provided. See L18_COMMUNITY.
rule_views.limits: Accepted for the total-slot question and consistent with the documented 3+1 effects; four simultaneous possessions were not directly observed.
rule_views.statement: Lisan confirms four Wilder Site slots for the stated combination of three Expedition Camp slots and Frontier Command.
rule_views.title: Expedition Camp plus Frontier Command slots
